definitions.short: Shual , the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H7777. Shuw 'al II. שׁוּעָל proper name, of a location district in Israel ; — שׁ ׳אֶרֶץ 1Sam 13:17 ( עָפְרָה דֶּרֶךְ ); not identified. — See also שׁ ׳חֲצַר above III. שׁוּעָל proper name, masculine in Asher ; — 1Chr 7:36 , Σουλα , A Σουαλ , ᵐ5 L Σουαν .

occurrences.englishText: The raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned to the way that leads to Ophrah, to the land of Shual;
The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
